abstract: Cloudways MCP lets AI tools manage your Cloudways servers. Set it up with an access token and test on a spare server first.

citation.name: Cloudways support: how to use the Cloudways MCP server

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

mainEntity.name: What is the Cloudways MCP server?

acceptedAnswer.text: It lets MCP-compatible AI tools run actions on your Cloudways servers from plain-language requests.

mainEntity.name: Which AI tools work with Cloudways MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloudways lists Claude, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI and Codex, among others.

mainEntity.name: How do I connect Cloudways MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Get an access token, add https://mcp.cloudways.com/mcp/ with the X-Access-Token and X-Mcp-Host headers, then ask for your server list.

mainEntity.name: Is the Cloudways API key method still supported?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloudways says the API key method is deprecated by 15 October 2026. Use an access token.

mainEntity.name: Is Cloudways MCP safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its tools include deleting servers. Start with a test server and read-only requests.
